title: Sohl Glass Display Cabinet $99.99 @ ALDI
body:
Deal: Sohl Glass Display Cabinet $99.99 @ ALDI

[ArtOfTheDeal] If only Aldi did delivery on these sorts of things. I bought one previously and it was so large and heavy there was no way to transport it home so I had to return it. Didn't fit in the car, and it was too heavy to even lift up to the boot. Aldi's not quite like Bunnings or a Whitegoods store where you can take a wide flat trolley down a ramp straight to boot.
That's just me though - this is supposed to be similar to the good discontinued Detolf IKEA ones.
[twocsies] Baggebo is cheaper at $59 if mesh sides are acceptable.
Hej,
Check out this BAGGEBO from IKEA.
https://applink.ikea.com/tY8M9r9M4w--10616682--au--en
[Masticccc] BAGGEBO is more for kitchen/dining stuff. This cabinet is more for general display. The mesh and huge frame is a dealbreaker for many people who want unobstructed views.
[Vladdo] I guess if you can't lift it into the trolley you can't lift it into the boot…
But yeah, i'd like to buy a 75inch tv but have no way of getting it home.
[backupper1] order an Airtasker, meet at Aldi, order in person and he/she takes care if it from there.
[Leonard0880] Any risk the guy may disappear after loaded the big item on his truck?
[JownehFixIT] I was lucky to fit two powder coated steel racking shelves down the centre channel of our car a few years ago but it wasn't easy or fun…
[Cataclysm] Got this to display switch games and toy. The lock is very weak
[TheGman101] This or the IKEA version?
https://www.ikea.com/au/en/p/blaliden-glass-door-cabinet-bla…
[Masticccc] Blaliden has different size, this one is basically a 1:1 replica of the discontinued IKEA Detolf
[TheGman101] Yeah but I do think the IKEA is sleeker with the black frame instead of having seeing the tiered platforms like the ALDI.
[Masticccc] Preference I guess, for me the frame of Blaliden obstructs too much when not looking directly at the front.
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] @Masticccc:
for me the frame of Blaliden obstructs too much when not looking directly at the front.
yes that is the exact reason the Detolf was so popular. looked great and decent quality for the price.
you don't want a black bar breaking your vision. Gman having preferences wrong way around imo.
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] this one is basically a 1:1 replica of the discontinued IKEA Detolf
that's what I was interested in.
how it compares to IKEA Detolf? (no longer available permanently)
how is ALDI quality? I heard IKEA Detolf quality went to s&*t before they discontinued it. so if ALDI is better than that then good?
[stenchlord] This reminds me of the old IKEA Detolf cases I used to own.
[No Client List] Just what I've been looking for to display my head collection.
err I meant my plate collection.
[FeetOffTheTable] You don't need to display pictures of all the times you did that act, mate.
[Mikael] These were so popular in the 80s. Remember Grandma having these and her crystal animal figurines in it.
[PainToad] Going to print out my OzBargain comments and display them in this.
[Masticccc] I post the deal for the same product last year, can check it here for more info.
I believe ALDI restocks this once every year on August as Father's Day special, so if stocks run out you have to wait till August next year. Or grab a similar one for nearly twice the price at Fantastic Furniture
[DevGuy] I believe the FF cabinet holds much more weight, so you could put for example some polystone statues in it (assuming height works). Detolfs crashing out are a thing.
[Masticccc] I don't have much trust on FF cabinet 10kg/shelf until I have one myself, but yes if that's correct then FF is better. Still not twice the price better imo, but the white base + top is a plus for anyone want that color.
[bchliu] Let me know when the equivalent of MILSBO goes on sale or something..
https://www.ikea.com/au/en/p/milsbo-glass-door-cabinet-white…
I got two of the old Detolf ones but ran out of room so have to upsize.
[Davbar24] These are great for LEGO, use door seals to make them dust free!
[Munkeyalan] I bought one of these last year and it's been great for my vintage star wars toy collection. The lock keeps the kids out but the clear display keeps the ladies queuing up around the block.
[No Client List] … keeps the ladies queuing up around the block
ok Jason Arday
[ATangk] I got one of these for $50 or $70 after they go in clearance. Depends on your risk as there’s usually always some left.
[liam2040] The Special Buys Stock Checker is good for that … bit of a mexican standoff as you see the stores go out of stock.
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] $50 or $70 after they go in clearance.
$50 sounds great. thanks.
[QuickToThePointless] could be good for lego homages from aliexpress
[Subada] Use mine for a liquor cabinet. Holds lots of booze and kept the 9 month old out despite his banging it with his hands
[paloverde88] Will wait for the frosted glass version for privacy
[hopper] thanks OP, finally i can showcase unopened boxes that i got from Ozbargain
[tenpercent] What shelf do you put the anko peelers on?
[Gigrantor] I have 2 of these, they are great for Hot Toys, statues and action figures.
I also have 2 cabinets from Fantastic Furniture as well as 2 tall wood/glass cabinets.
I'm almost tempted to get another one but I'm running out of space!
